sources.title: UGC University Admissions Handbook 2025/2026, sections 1.2 and 1.7
sources.scope: Academic year 2025/2026; internal undergraduate admission under this handbook. Printed pp.9 and13 (PDF pp.16 and20). Year-scoped published rules, not individual or future-intake eligibility.
statements: Section 1.2 requires three approved A/L subject S passes in one sitting within three attempts, plus at least 30% for the Common General Paper.
A prior Common General Paper result of at least 30% within those three attempts can be considered; otherwise the handbook describes obtaining it in a later permitted attempt before registration.

Section 1.7 excludes applicants who sat A/Ls on more than three occasions from internal admission under its scope. Attempts need not be consecutive; using an earlier result does not bypass this exclusion.
Minimum requirements do not establish selection: course prerequisites, Z-score, district and other admission rules still apply.

sources.title: Department of Examinations A/L 2021 private-candidate application and technical instructions
sources.scope: Historical 2021 examination instructions dated 5 July 2021, particularly pp.1-4 and 6. Not verified as the rules for the next examination.
statements: The 2021 instructions provided a private-candidate application route, with attempt number recorded separately from subject choices.
The 2021 notice distinguished candidates who did not appear even for part of a paper and advised retaining the admission card as evidence of non-appearance.
It prohibited government-school pupils from applying privately while still enrolled. Confirm current school/private-candidate rules before applying.

sources.title: Department of Examinations official online services portal
sources.scope: Official portal checked on 17 October 2026. A portal listing is not evidence that a future A/L application window is open.
statements: The official portal provides separate private and school login routes and examination-specific notices.
The checked page did not establish a next-examination retake application window, fee or individual permission.

policy_notes: [ugc-handbook-2025-26] Sitting an examination again is distinct from eligibility for UGC internal admission. Do not treat the handbook attempt limit as a universal ban on further examination sittings.
[ugc-handbook-2025-26] Do not combine main-subject passes from different sittings to claim the handbook minimum. Its stated earlier-result provision concerns the Common General Paper.
[ugc-handbook-2025-26] This guidance is year-scoped and advisory. Confirm the relevant handbook, course requirements and personal admission history with UGC; no selection outcome is established.

[doe-private-instructions-2021] Non-appearance and candidate-category examples are historical, not an automatic current attempt counter. Ask the Department of Examinations how the student’s actual record is treated.
[doe-current-portal] Confirm the next examination’s published application instructions, dates and charges through the official portal. No current registration permission or fee is inferred here.
